Case: the spec home is unreachable and a classification was recorded anyway
Asserts: A2
Home: unreachable
Records: 1
Expect: finding
Findings: 1
Why: R19 violated, and this is the whole point of the check. The tree is
  01-stopped with one classification record added: the spec is not there, so
  whatever this classification was made against, it was not the living spec.
  The record's own provenance is well formed on purpose - a valid commit and a
  valid hash - so that A3 cannot fire here and the finding can only be A2.
